source.sql: SELECT c.relname AS name, i.indisunique AS unique, i.indisvalid AS valid, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 1, true) AS first_column, CASE WHEN i.indnkeyatts > 1 THEN pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 2, true) ELSE NULL END AS second_column FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('daily_entries_pkey','daily_entries_user_id_date_key','idx_daily_entries_user_date','idx_users_email','users_email_key') ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT 'users' AS table_name, count(*)::int AS count, md5(COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'email',email) ORDER BY id)::text,'[]')) AS digest FROM public.users UNION ALL SELECT 'habits', count(*)::int, md5(COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'user_id',user_id,'key',key,'label',label) ORDER BY id)::text,'[]')) FROM public.habits UNION ALL SELECT 'daily_entries', count(*)::int, md5(COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'user_id',user_id,'date',date,'sleep_data',sleep_data,'habits',habits) ORDER BY id)::text,'[]')) FROM public.daily_entries ORDER BY table_name
